name: Freshdesk
oneLiner: Freshworks' AI-powered helpdesk for ticketing across email, chat, phone and social, with Freddy AI agents, copilot and insights. Freshdesk Omni is the omnichannel edition.
bestFor: Small and mid-size teams that want an affordable multichannel helpdesk with AI self-service they can grow into.

updates.text: At Refresh, Freshworks launched the Freshdesk Command Center (one workspace for multichannel conversations with Freddy AI Copilot built in), Vertical AI Agents for ecommerce, fintech, travel and logistics with 50+ prebuilt workflows in Freddy AI Agent Studio, and Freddy AI Insights.
Freddy AI Agent Studio, a no-code tool to build, test and monitor AI agents.

features: Ticketing from email, chat, phone and social in one inbox
Freddy AI Agent for automated answers on chat and email, built in AI Agent Studio
Freddy AI Copilot: summaries, suggested replies and next actions (add-on on Pro and Enterprise)
Freddy AI Insights for trends and anomaly alerts
Automations for assignment, SLAs and follow-ups
Team collaboration with private notes, shared ownership and parent-child tickets
Integrations such as Shopify, Stripe and FedEx for order lookups

pricing.text: Growth $19, Pro $55 and Enterprise $89 per agent per month, billed annually (the page says annual billing saves 20%). No free plan is listed; new accounts get a 14-day trial of the Enterprise plan, and the account is suspended if you don't continue. Each paid plan includes 500 Freddy AI Agent sessions once per account; more cost $49 per 100 sessions. Freddy AI Copilot is $29 per agent per month on Pro and Enterprise.

notes: freshworks.com could not be fetched from this session; prices come from a search of the official pricing page (snippet) and match several 2026 third-party guides, which say prices rose in 2026 from $15/$49/$79. The free plan (original said up to 10 agents) is no longer clearly offered; sources conflict, so it is left out. Dineout case study is hosted on third-party sites (iotone), not freshworks.com. Original 'reducing manual workload significantly' dropped. 2026-11: the Freshdesk pricing page was opened directly; prices, the 14-day Enterprise trial, the 500 included AI Agent sessions, $49 per 100 extra sessions and the $29 Copilot add-on come from it, and it lists no free plan. G2 rating (4.4, 3,754 reviews) from G2 search result snippets; g2.com returned 403.
pros: Entry price of $19 per agent per month (Growth, billed annually)
Email, chat, phone and social tickets in one inbox
500 Freddy AI Agent sessions included on paid plans (once per account)
No-code Freddy AI Agent Studio to build, test and monitor AI agents

cons.text: No free plan on the pricing page; a 14-day Enterprise trial, then the account is suspended unless you pay
Freddy AI Copilot is a $29 per agent per month add-on, offered on Pro and Enterprise only
AI Agent sessions beyond the included 500 cost $49 per 100
A general-purpose helpdesk, so restaurant review replies and guest surveys need another tool
